nodes.description: Private mapping (address => uint256) _balances holding token balances of every holder.
Private nested mapping _allowances[owner][spender] storing ERC20 spending approvals.
Private _tTotal = 1000*10**9*10**18, the fixed total supply.
Private address _owner written in the Ownable constructor and read by owner().
Private address newComer initialised to _msgSender() at deployment; used by the onlyOwner modifier instead of _owner (hidden privileged address).
msg.sender / _msgSender(), attacker-controllable caller address used for minting, ownership and transfers.
Constructor: mints _tTotal to _msgSender() and initialises Ownable state.
Context._msgSender() internal view helper returning msg.sender.
_approve(ol, tt, amount) private: writes _allowances but silently zeroes the allowance when ol != owner().
approve(spender, amount) public: delegates to _approve for the caller.
transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount) public: performs _transfer then re-approves remaining allowance.
transfer(recipient, amount) public: transfers from _msgSender() via _transfer.
_transfer(sender, recipient, amount) internal: performs SafeMath sub/add on _balances and emits Transfer.
allowance(owner, spender) view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
balanceOf(account) view returning _balances[account].
totalSupply() view returning _tTotal.
owner() view returning the stored _owner (not used by the modifier).
renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner: sets _owner to address(0).
transferOwnership(newOwner) private onlyOwner: transfers ownership to a new address.
onlyOwner modifier: requires newComer == _msgSender(), i.e. the deployer-time address captured in state.
Unsafe low-level value call recipient.call{value: amount}("") inside Address.sendValue/_functionCallWithValue.
Unsafe allowance reset: _allowances[ol][tt] forced to 0 when the approver is not owner().
name() view returning the _name string.
symbol() view returning the _symbol string.
decimals() view returning _decimals (18).
Parameter sender of _transfer.
Parameter recipient of _transfer.
Parameter amount of _transfer.
Parameter ol (owner/from address) of _approve.
Parameter tt (spender/to address) of _approve.
Parameter amount of _approve.
Parameter spender of the public approve function.
Parameter amount of the public approve function.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership.
Local variable msgSender in the Ownable constructor holding _msgSender().
Parameter sender of transferFrom.
Parameter recipient of transferFrom.
Parameter amount of transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the deployer that receives the entire initial supply in the constructor.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender.
approve passes _msgSender() as the ol argument of _approve.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() for allowance bookkeeping.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the token movement.
onlyOwner compares the caller (msg.sender) with the privileged newComer state.
Constructor writes _balances[_msgSender()] = _tTotal.
Ownable constructor sets _owner to the deployer.
Deployment captures newComer = _msgSender(), the address that later satisfies onlyOwner.
onlyOwner reads the hidden newComer state variable to authorise the caller.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
owner() returns the stored _owner.
_approve compares ol against owner() to decide whether to zero the allowance.
Public approve forwards to the privileged-logic _approve.
transferFrom calls the internal _transfer.
transferFrom re-invokes _approve to update the remaining allowance.
_approve writes into the _allowances mapping.
allowance() reads the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom reads and debits the stored allowance.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
_transfer performs SafeMath sub/add on _balances entries.
totalSupply() returns _tTotal.
transfer calls the internal _transfer.
When ol != owner() the private _approve silently resets the allowance to zero.
Constructor calls _msgSender() to obtain the deployer address.
approve calls _msgSender().
transferFrom calls _msgSender().
transfer calls _msgSender().
sender parameter drives the balance debit inside _transfer.
recipient parameter drives the balance credit inside _transfer.
amount parameter is the quantity subtracted and added in _transfer.
ol controls the owner comparison branch that zeroes allowances.
tt is the spender key written into _allowances.
amount is the approved value written into _allowances.
spender argument of approve is forwarded to _approve.
amount argument of approve is forwarded to _approve.
newOwner parameter replaces the privileged _owner address.
Local msgSender from the constructor is written into newComer.
sender parameter of transferFrom is spent from.
recipient parameter of transferFrom receives the tokens.
amount parameter of transferFrom is forwarded to _transfer and allowance subtraction.
Low-level value call into an arbitrary recipient can re-enter token transfer logic before state settlement.

normalization_plan.reason: sender is only a local binding of _transfer's first argument.
recipient is only a local binding of _transfer's second argument.
amount is the local quantifier used by _transfer's SafeMath operations.
ol is the owner/from argument used solely inside _approve.
tt is the spender/to argument used solely inside _approve.
amount is the value written to _allowances inside _approve.
spender is the public entry argument forwarded by approve to _approve.
amount is the public entry argument forwarded by approve to _approve.
newOwner is only used to overwrite _owner inside transferOwnership.
msgSender only holds _msgSender() during constructor execution.
sender is the from-account argument of transferFrom.
recipient is the to-account argument of transferFrom.
amount is the quantity moved and debited from the allowance in transferFrom.
